contrib.name: health-chi
contrib.summary: Chi adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — exposes liveness, readiness, and startup probes as stdlib `http.Handler`s with a Chi-native `Mount` helper.

contrib.name: health-dns
contrib.summary: DNS adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — implements `health.Checker` by resolving a host via a DNS resolver.

contrib.name: health-echo
contrib.summary: Echo adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — exposes liveness, readiness, and startup probes as `echo.HandlerFunc`s with a `Mount` helper.

contrib.name: health-fiber
contrib.summary: Fiber adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — exposes liveness, readiness, and startup probes as `fiber.Handler`s with a `Mount` helper.

contrib.name: health-gin
contrib.summary: Gin adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — exposes liveness, readiness, and startup probes as `gin.HandlerFunc`s with a `Mount` helper.

contrib.name: health-httpprobe
contrib.summary: Generic outbound HTTP probe for `github.com/ubgo/health` — implements `health.Checker` by issuing a GET to a configured URL and accepting any 2xx/3xx response.

contrib.name: health-nats
contrib.summary: NATS adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — implements `health.Checker` based on the connection state of a NATS client.

contrib.name: health-nethttp
contrib.summary: Stdlib `net/http` adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — exposes liveness, readiness, and startup probes as `http.Handler`s with a `Mount` helper.

contrib.name: health-otel
contrib.summary: OpenTelemetry adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — emits an OTEL span for every check the registry runs by subscribing as a `health.Observer`.

contrib.name: health-postgres
contrib.summary: Postgres adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — implements `health.Checker` for a Postgres connection or pool, using pgx's `Ping` method.

contrib.name: health-prom
contrib.summary: Prometheus adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — exposes health checks as Prometheus metrics by subscribing as a `health.Observer`.

contrib.name: health-redis
contrib.summary: Redis adapter for `github.com/ubgo/health` — implements `health.Checker` by running the Redis `PING` command via go-redis.

examples.title: How the pieces fit together
examples.code:
reg := health.NewRegistry()
reg.Register(healthredis.New("cache", redisClient))     // CHECKER
reg.Register(healthpostgres.New("db",  pgxPool))        // CHECKER
healthotel.Register(reg)                                // OBSERVER
healthgin.Mount(r, reg)                                 // RENDERER
